name: RSS Daily Digest
description: Read a configured RSS/Atom profile, select relevant fresh stories, read shortlisted articles when needed, and refresh a concise Canvas digest. Example: /rss_digest daily_tech.

variables.publication_status: No new digest was published; the current Canvas page was kept.

steps.description: Fetch current feeds and gather bounded fresh candidates
Shortlist relevant story IDs and validate them against this feed batch
Read only shortlisted articles whose feeds did not include full content
Publish a fresh reader-friendly Canvas digest at its stable title
Record published story IDs only after Canvas confirms success

abort_speech: The RSS digest could not finish. Unpublished stories remain eligible for a later run; check the failed step before retrying.
